odataPage.title: OData
odataPage.description: Open the tables your role can see in Excel, Power BI or any OData client, with no driver to install.
odataPage.serviceRootHelp: In Excel or Power BI, choose OData feed and paste this address. Sign in with Basic or a bearer token.
odataPage.metadataHelp: The tables, columns and relationships your role can see, as OData CSDL.
odataPage.noEntitySets: Your role is served no entity sets.
odataPage.filterHint: For example: Price gt 10 and startswith(Name,'A')
odataPage.selectHint: The properties to return; none returns every property.
odataPage.expandHint: The related entities to return with each row.
odataPage.orderByHint: The order of the rows, first key first.
